$comment: Baseline trace set. Dates are relative to T0 (2026-01-01T00:00:00Z) through offsetHours, resolved by the seed helper against the FakeClock — never an absolute timestamp here.

memories.content: The auth middleware rejected valid tokens: the expiry check used < instead of <=, so a token expiring on the exact second read as expired.
SQLite in WAL mode with busy_timeout at 5000ms removes SQLITE_BUSY on concurrent intra-process writes.
The forgetting curve is driven by levelThresholds in hours: 24h for L1, 168h for L2, 720h for L3, 2160h for L4.
Critical trace flagged photographic: it must never decay, however much time passes.
